_about: Labelled claim-check pairs for the research claim checker (written 2026-10-16, before measuring): realistic multi-sentence passages with reference markers; 'yes' = the passage says it, 'no' = it does not (swapped entity, wrong place or date, negation, or an added fact).

passages.P1: Python is a high-level programming language.[3] Guido van Rossum began working on Python in the late 1980s as a successor to the ABC language. Van Rossum first published the code (for Python version 0.9.1) to alt.sources in February 1991.[14][15] Several features of the language were already present at this stage, among them classes with inheritance, exception handling, functions, and the core datatypes of list, dict, str and so on.
passages.P2: The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France.[1] It is named after the engineer Gustave Eiffel, whose company designed and built the tower from 1887 to 1889. Locally nicknamed La dame de fer, it was constructed as the centrepiece of the 1889 World's Fair.[2] The tower is 330 metres tall, about the same height as an 81-storey building.
passages.P3: Canberra is the capital city of Australia.[a] Founded following the federation of the colonies of Australia as the seat of government for the new nation, it is Australia's largest inland city. The site was selected in 1908 as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne, the two largest cities. Construction of the city began in 1913.
passages.P4: The seasons are caused by the tilt of Earth's rotational axis relative to its orbital plane. The axis is tilted by about 23.4 degrees.[5] Because of this tilt, each hemisphere receives more direct sunlight during part of the year. The distance between Earth and the Sun changes only slightly over the year and is not the main cause of the seasons.
passages.P5: At sea level, water boils at 100 degrees Celsius, which is 212 degrees Fahrenheit.[7] The boiling point decreases as altitude increases because the air pressure is lower. At the summit of Mount Everest, water boils at about 70 degrees Celsius.
